note: Browser eval tasks. Fixture tasks run on local pages in evals/browser/sites and need no accounts; live tasks need a signed-in Chromium profile (MISTY_BROWSER_EVAL_PROFILE) and the start URL in the named variable. A check runs in the page and must return true; expect strings must all appear in the final answer; a rubric is graded by the judge.

tasks.prompt: Create a Northwind account for Ada Lovelace (ada@example.com) on the Pro plan in Canada, accepting the terms.
